definitions.gloss: despite; in spite of; although; even though
definitions.explanation: Formal expression for contrast between expectation and reality.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}にも{関|かか}わらず、{試合|しあい}は{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: Despite the rain, the match was held.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しいにも{関|かか}わらず、{手伝|てつだ}ってくれた。
examples.english: Although she was busy, she helped me.

examples.japanese: {注意|ちゅうい}したにも{関|かか}わらず、また{同|おな}じ{失敗|しっぱい}をした。
examples.english: Despite being warned, he made the same mistake again.

notes:
にも{関|かか}わらず is a formal conjunction meaning "despite."

GRAMMAR PATTERNS:
・[noun] + にも{関|かか}わらず
・[verb plain form] + にも{関|かか}わらず
・[i-adjective] + にも{関|かか}わらず
・[na-adjective + な/である] + にも{関|かか}わらず

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal, often in written Japanese. In casual speech, のに is more common.

SIMILAR:
・のに - although (casual)
・けれども / が - but (neutral)
